content.short: Ziion Linux distro is a blockchain and smart contract security operating system (OS).
content.description: Ziion Linux distro is developed by an organization led by Steven Walbroehl and Rob Behnke, consisting of 100 hackers who are core developers. Users can download precompiled security tools and run them against their Dapps to stay ahead of security vulnerabilities. Developers can leverage language-specific tools to adhere to standards that secure the execution of their smart contracts. Ziion emphasizes an offensive approach to security rather than a reactive one.
